moments.title: Halloween Weekend Approaches
moments.blurb: The UK is gearing up for Halloween on Saturday, October 31st, with events and spooky celebrations planned nationwide.

angles.name: Costume Countdown

moments.title: England's Rugby League World Cup Decider
moments.blurb: England faces France on Saturday, October 24th, needing a significant win to keep their Rugby League World Cup semi-final hopes alive after an opening loss to Tonga.

angles.name: Crucial Clash
angles.copy: It's do or die for England in the Rugby League World Cup! Can they secure a big win against France on Saturday to keep their semi-final dreams alive?

angles.name: National Pride
angles.copy: All eyes on England this Saturday as they battle France in a must-win Rugby League World Cup clash. Send your support for the Lions!

moments.title: EFL Cup Fourth Round Action
moments.blurb: The Carabao Cup Fourth Round kicks off next week (w/c Oct 26), with fixtures including Fleetwood Town vs Arsenal (Oct 27) and Manchester City vs Brighton (Oct 28).

angles.name: Cup Drama
angles.copy: Midweek football magic! The Carabao Cup 4th Round brings Arsenal, Man City and more into action next week. Who's heading for an upset?

angles.name: Big Team Clashes
angles.copy: Arsenal face Fleetwood, Man City take on Brighton in the Carabao Cup next week. Expect drama!

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Fixtures
moments.blurb: This weekend's Premier League action features Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur on Saturday, and Liverpool vs Brighton, Man Utd vs Bournemouth on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Footy

angles.copy: Big London derby as Chelsea host Spurs this Saturday! Plus, key clashes across the league on Sunday. Who are you backing?

moments.title: Halloween Weekend Premier League Blockbusters
moments.blurb: The Premier League serves up massive clashes over the Halloween weekend, including Chelsea vs Manchester United on Saturday, October 31st, and Liverpool vs Arsenal on Sunday, November 1st.

angles.name: Spooky Showdowns
angles.copy: Forget the tricks, get ready for treats! Halloween weekend brings Chelsea vs Man Utd and Liverpool vs Arsenal in the Premier League. What a lineup!

angles.name: Title Race Impact
angles.copy: Huge games for the title race this Halloween weekend! Chelsea vs Man Utd and Liverpool vs Arsenal could be season-defining. Who needs the points more?

moments.title: Taylor Swift Holds UK Singles Chart No. 1
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is currently the UK Official Singles Chart No. 1, with a new chart set to be revealed tomorrow, Friday October 23rd.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Is anyone going to knock Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' off the UK Singles Chart top spot? The new chart is out tomorrow! What's your prediction?

angles.name: New Music Friday Eve
angles.copy: It's New Music Friday Eve! Who's hoping to see their favourite new track storm the charts tomorrow? Any contenders for No. 1?

angles.name: Binge Watch Alert
